# ZX Spectrum 48K ROM

`48.rom` is the unmodified 16 KB Spectrum 48K ROM, taken from `roms/48.rom` in the
Fuse emulator source release `fuse-1.6.0.tar.gz`
(https://sourceforge.net/projects/fuse-emulator/files/fuse/1.6.0/).

- Size: 16384 bytes
- CRC32: `0xDDEE531F`
- SHA-256: `d55daa439b673b0e3f5897f99ac37ecb45f974d1862b4dadb85dec34af99cb42`

The ROM is copyright Amstrad plc. Amstrad has given permission to distribute the
unmodified Spectrum ROMs with emulators.
